rdfs:label: tag
rdfs:comment: Objects or Links associated with the subject by reference (unlike `attachment`, by inclusion) — in ActivityPub typically `Mention` (an @-mentioned actor) or `Hashtag` entries; a tag does not address or deliver to anyone.
notes: ActivityStreams' inline-mention slot — used by ActivityPub posts to attach `as:Hashtag` or `as:Mention` references that surface in the body. Repeat to list multiple tags. Distinct from `urn:solid:attachment` (association by inclusion), `urn:solid:subject` (broader topical metadata) and `urn:solid:audience` / `urn:solid:to` (intended recipients — tagging someone does not address them).

history.note: Replaced wrong (bcc-like) comment with the AS2 tag definition; added seeAlso Mention/Hashtag/attachment and notToBeConfusedWith; example uses urn:solid:Mention/href.
